description.value: The Travelodge by Wyndham McBride is a branded chain hotel situated on the North West Frontage Road in McBride, a small community in BC's Robson Valley along Highway 16. As one of the few commercial accommodations in this remote stretch of the Interior, it serves as a key overnight stop for cyclists touring the region between Prince George and Jasper. The property operates under the Travelodge/Wyndham brand with Wyndham Rewards loyalty program integration.
